name: Vital-Side (Rewire brain-retraining membership)
founders: Lindsay Mitchell, PA-C (founder/CEO; BS Biology, Univ. of Nevada; Master of PA Studies; NLP/EFT/TFT practitioner; former 'chronic Lyme' patient)
Bianca Spears (laughter-wellness coach; co-founder of the Elevate and Regulation Station sub-programs only, not of Vital-Side)
founded_year_range: 2017-2018. The About page says the program was conceived in 2017 and officially started in 2018. The first Wayback capture is 2018-08-06.
cost_summary: Rewire costs USD 397/year, auto-renewing (verified Oct 2026). Codes REWIRE20 (20% off) and ELEVATE50 are advertised. Elevate costs USD 99 per 3 months (verified). Private 1:1 sessions and Deep Dive group calls are extra. Reset is a low-cost 7-day intro. In Sept 2020 Rewire was USD 279, with a USD 139 sale price (Wayback). No refunds on any memberships or sessions.
mechanisms: limbic system impairment / amygdala threat conditioning
autonomic/nervous system dysregulation (sympathetic overdrive, "stuck in fight-or-flight")
mechanism_summary: Chronic symptoms are attributed to a conditioned chronic stress response. After an accumulated infectious, toxic or emotional load, the brain's threat circuitry ("limbic system impairment," a term borrowed from DNRS) keeps the sympathetic nervous system stuck in fight-flight-freeze, or "survival mode." This is said to block parasympathetic "growth and repair." Repeated mental exercises are claimed to rewire these circuits through neuroplasticity, and the site also claims they change "epigenetic" gene expression, without citations. The body is then said to heal itself. One model is applied to 50+ diagnoses.
techniques: Proprietary 'Rewire 7 Steps' retraining sequence (Module 4: interrupt the symptom/trigger response, then redirect to positive states and visualisation)
'State changers': brief interrupts when a symptom appears
'Incremental Progress': graded re-exposure to avoided foods, chemicals and activities
20-60 min of daily practice; a 6-month commitment
10+ hour video course with a 64-page personalised guidebook
EFT tapping, NLP tools, visualisation, breathing, movement
private community, staff messaging, coach-led group calls, paid Deep Dives and 1:1 sessions
Elevate: 6 phases, 38 tools and a 68-page guidebook, an advanced course for graduates of DNRS, Gupta, Lightning Process, Rocksteady or Vital-Side
mainstream_notes: Sold direct to consumers. I found no adoption by a health system, guideline body or payer. The founder holds a PA-C credential, but the program disclaims medical advice, and its coaches have non-clinical backgrounds.
insurance_notes: The site mentions no insurance or HSA/FSA billing. It is an auto-renewing consumer membership with no refunds.
controversy: The program claims to address organic diseases (Lyme, RA, MCAS, CIRS, "hormonal imbalance") and 50+ conditions with one brain-retraining model, without outcome data. Its self-reported statistics ("10,000+ helped," "92% massive transformation") have no published method or denominator. It makes uncited epigenetic claims and calls the power to heal from within "a scientific fact." It leans on a PA-C credential while disclaiming medical advice, and sells a no-refund, auto-renewing subscription. It shares the general ME/CFS advocacy critique of limbic-retraining programs. I found no specific published critique of Vital-Side.

indicators.metric: Podcast episodes (The Vital Side Podcast, formerly Rewire)

indicators.value: Rewire, Reset, Reboot, Elevate, Regulation Station, kids coaching

popularity.reach_estimate: About 10^4. The company claims more than 10,000 participants, which is unaudited and may include intro-course users.
popularity.method_notes: The trajectory is anchored on: Wayback captures (launched Aug 2018); the 2020 price; the podcast running 2021-2025 with 180 episodes; product-line expansion in 2023-2024; and the claimed user count of more than 10,000. Growth after 2020 is assumed to follow the long-COVID wave. The web-search quota was exhausted in both the research and fact-check sessions, so Reddit, Google Trends and social follower counts were not checked. Values are coarse within-program estimates.

sources: PubMed E-utilities: "vital-side" OR (Mitchell L[Author] AND brain retraining) - 9 hits, none relevant (checked 2026-10-12)
